note: First measurement of the flux-averaged, restricted-phase-space cross section for Cabibbo-suppressed direct Lambda-baryon production, anti-nu_mu + Ar -> mu+ + Lambda + X (Lambda -> p pi-), on argon. Combined MicroBooNE NuMI FHC (2.2e20 POT, nu-mode) + RHC (4.9e20 POT, antinu-mode) exposure; the flux Phi in the cross-section formula is the total anti-nu_mu flux across both run configurations (the process is exclusively anti-neutrino-induced even in FHC running). Not differential in any kinematic variable — a single flux-integrated total, obtained via a Bayesian posterior on sigma_R = (N_obs - B) / (T*Phi*Gamma*epsilon). Target: per Ar (per argon nucleus, restricted-phase-space, i.e. only Lambda baryons decaying above MicroBooNE's proton >0.3 GeV/c and pi- >0.1 GeV/c detection thresholds — NOT the total/unrestricted Lambda-production cross section).
